$schema_note: Non-secret custody inventory. NAMES, ROLES AND CUSTODY METADATA ONLY, per SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT.SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.CONSEQUENT_BINDING_REQUIREMENT. No credential VALUE, DSN, userinfo, password hash, vault handle or lookup token may ever be added to this file, by any lane, at any beat.

correction_record.why_this_file_is_corrected_in_place_rath: OD-2 fixes THIS EXACT PATH as the custody inventory. A v1.0.1 at a second path would make the inventory report two holders where there is one, which SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.rotation_mechanics forbids and which is the precise failure an inventory exists to prevent. The file is also mutable by design: DAG node N12 UPDATES this same entry after the mint, and N28 closes it. Correcting it in place is what its own lifecycle contemplates.
correction_record.governing_authority_is_NOT_edited: docs/ops/release/FIBDB053_D1_AUDITOR_N06_CUSTODY_INVENTORY_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json is append-only and remains BYTE-INTACT at blob 5408cc7cc00cceb3816e5c43ad09678fddc81aa1. The two clauses of that authority which these corrections supersede are recorded append-only in the consolidated closure authority, not written back into it.

DAG node N05 was certified SATISFIED by the independent R2 recertification of PR #219 at 1c47566357f06fdc41280297bc7bc2e8bed4d504 (D1_AUDITOR_CUSTODY_REALIZATION_R2_RECERT_PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS; registry occurrence CERT-OCC-CUSTODY-REALIZATION-R2), on a non-secret sentinel. metadata_only_semantics_preserved.rule: UNCHANGED AND UNWEAKENED by every correction this lane applied. Not one of them adds, or creates room for, a value of any prohibited class.
metadata_only_semantics_preserved.NEVER_A_VALUE: No credential in any form redacted or not, no DSN, no userinfo, no password hash or rolpassword value, no direct host string as distinct from the ConnectionMechanism enum, and no vault handle, entry key or lookup token that would itself retrieve the value. The last is OF-DAG-6's derived addition and is carried here in full.
metadata_only_semantics_preserved.what_changed_and_what_did_not: The corrections changed hole REPRESENTATION (an empty array to null), hole ATTRIBUTION (naming N31 as the planned_removal_date producer), and RECORDING SEQUENCE (fields are recorded at N06, before N10). No field was populated, no value was supplied, and no new field can hold a secret.

processes_or_environments.holds_the_value: At rest, DPAPI-protected, CRED_TYPE_GENERIC, CRED_PERSIST_LOCAL_MACHINE, in the human custodian's Windows user profile.
processes_or_environments.lifetime: From the N30 deposit until the governed removal (N24 for a re-rotated value, N28 at closure). It SURVIVES an abrupt kill of any process by design; there is no automatic sweep for the real entry.
processes_or_environments.basis: CERTIFIED_MECHANISM_SURFACE: measured in the certified N05 demonstration on a sentinel.
processes_or_environments.why_no_entry_key: OF-DAG-6: a vault entry key or lookup token is never recorded in this file.

processes_or_environments.holds_the_value: powershell.exe running the fixed bridge, for the duration of ONE deposit (N30) or ONE retrieval (N23) call: .NET strings and zeroed-then-freed unmanaged buffers. Its environment is an allowlist that never carries the delivery variable; the value crosses only its stdin/stdout pipes.

The process that runs runWithDeliveredSecret. After a delivery its heap holds the one environment string spawn requires and the strings Node/libuv derive from it — measured at about three one-byte and one or two UTF-16 copies. NOT zeroed; no zeroization is claimed.
processes_or_environments.lifetime: The launcher's whole lifetime (OF-CUST-1). The launcher must therefore be short-lived, must run from a console, and must not run under a development runtime.
processes_or_environments.basis: CERTIFIED_MECHANISM_SURFACE: measured by an external memory scan of a clean launcher.

processes_or_environments.holds_the_value: UELLIX_AUDITOR_DATABASE_URL in the environment block of exactly ONE consuming child process, created at CreateProcess by runWithDeliveredSecret, without CREATE_NO_WINDOW and not detached, so it shares the launcher's console and has no conhost of its own, and sits in the launcher's kill-on-close job.
processes_or_environments.lifetime: The consumer's lifetime; destroyed by the OS at exit, including on kill.
processes_or_environments.basis: FUTURE_REAL_EXECUTION_SURFACE derived from the CERTIFIED_MECHANISM_SURFACE of the certified sentinel consumer.
processes_or_environments.OPEN_SUBITEM_reason: The concrete consumer command for the real credential (N23-N25) is the production-invocation decision, which is not yet made. It must run under a bare runtime, spawn no descendant carrying the value, and have its topology re-demonstrated wherever it differs from the certified sentinel consumer.

processes_or_environments_provenance.closure_path_per_governing_authority: DAG node N05 (N06 authority FIELD_DISPOSITION). N05 is SATISFIED.
processes_or_environments_provenance.what_is_listed: Every surface that WILL hold the real credential under the certified mechanism, which is what N06's act asks for ('every process or environment that will hold it').
processes_or_environments_provenance.what_is_NOT_listed_and_why: Demonstration-only processes — the PEB observer, positive-control fixtures, the kill depositor, the sentinel consumer build — exist only in the sentinel demonstration and are not surfaces of the real credential.

entries.mint_date_hole_reason: EXPECTED to be absent. The mint (DAG node N11, MR-2) has not occurred. Populated only by DAG node N12, as an UPDATE to this entry, immediately after N11 verifies.
entries.expiry_policy: VALID_UNTIL = planned FINAL WITNESS time + 24 hours
entries.expiry_policy_basis: OD-3, ratified (RATIFIED_VALID_UNTIL_POLICY_OFFSET_24H_POST_WITNESS). An owner policy OFFSET, not yet a computable UTC timestamp.
entries.expiry_exact_utc_hole_reason: DAG node N09 computes this value from DAG node N08 (a concrete owner-supplied planned FINAL WITNESS timestamp), which remains unsupplied. No default, estimate, or open-ended value is substituted, per EXEC-NOTE-1.
entries.expiry_exact_utc_WHEN_IT_IS_RECORDED_HER: AT DAG NODE N06, STRICTLY BEFORE N10. Clarified by the CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CONSOLIDATED-CLOSURE-AW-R1 lane because the governing authority's own closure_path for this field reads 'that value is shown to the owner at HC-1 (N10) and recorded here only then', which cannot be executed as written: edge E-06-10 is HARD, so N10 MAY NOT BEGIN until N06's exit condition is satisfied, and that exit condition requires all seven pre-mint fields — this one included — to be present. A field first recorded at N10 could never have been present at N06. The correct sequence is: N09 computes the instant, N06 RECORDS it here, and only then does N10 STATE the already-recorded value to the owner as HC1-S4. HC-1 states this record; it does not create it.
entries.removal_policy: MANDATORY rotation and removal after the FINAL WITNESS
entries.planned_removal_date_hole_reason: STOP_SCHEMA_NEEDS_EXACT_REMOVAL_INSTANT. The owner supplied a calendar DATE (see planned_removal_date_owner_input_received). N31's act and exit condition require the planned removal as an EXACT UTC INSTANT, not earlier than the planned FINAL WITNESS instant N08 supplies, and N31 has N08 as a HARD precondition. N08 is unsupplied. No clock time is invented for the date: neither 00:00 nor 23:59 nor any other.

planned_removal_date_owner_input_receive.form: CALENDAR DATE, no time, no zone
planned_removal_date_owner_input_receive.status: RECEIVED, NOT BOUND. It becomes bindable only as an exact UTC instant on or within that date, supplied by the owner, after N08 exists and not earlier than N08's instant.
planned_removal_date_owner_input_receive.owner_constraint_supplied_with_it: planned_removal_date is independent of expiry_exact_utc and is never set equal to it by assumption. If N09 computes an expiry EARLIER than the planned removal, expiry is the hard outer bound and the removal must occur no later than the expiry.

entries.planned_removal_date_WHO_PRODUCES_IT: CORRECTED by the CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CONSOLIDATED-CLOSURE-AW-R1 lane. This field previously carried the hole reason 'Tied to the same unsupplied FINAL WITNESS timestamp that blocks expiry_exact_utc', and the governing authority gave it closure_path 'Same as expiry_exact_utc'. That closure path resolves to DAG node N09, whose act computes planned FINAL WITNESS + 24 hours — the VALID UNTIL, a different quantity. The field was attributed to a node that computes another value, and independent certification found it had NO PRODUCER NODE anywhere in the certified graph. N31 is that producer.
entries.planned_removal_date_CLASSIFICATION: HUMAN_SUPPLIED_EXECUTION_DATUM, not a mechanically derived schedule datum. The POLICY is already ratified at OD-1 (post-FINAL-WITNESS removal is MANDATORY) and is not reopened; what is missing is only the concrete planned instant implementing it. No ratified clause fixes an interval from the witness to the removal, so no derivation exists to perform.
entries.planned_removal_date_IS_NOT_EQUAL_TO_exp: NOT ASSERTED AND NOT ASSUMED. The two are distinct fields with distinct meanings: expiry_exact_utc is when the credential STOPS WORKING BY ITSELF under a hosted VALID UNTIL; planned_removal_date is when custody is planned to END BY AN ACT, the mandatory post-witness rotation and its removal verification. No controlling authority requires equality. The one bound that IS derivable and binding is that the removal is not planned earlier than the planned FINAL WITNESS instant (OD-1, 'rotation after the FINAL WITNESS'). Whether it must also fall at or before expiry_exact_utc is an OPEN OWNER INPUT and is not settled by inference.
entries.planned_removal_date_WHEN_IT_IS_RECORDED: AT DAG NODE N06, STRICTLY BEFORE N10, for the same E-06-10 HARD-ordering reason stated for expiry_exact_utc above. HC1-S6 ('when it will be removed') STATES this record to the owner; it does not create it.
